Moradia geminada Bi-Familiar com entradas Independentes

 Moradia geminada T3 com 120m² área habitável total. Moradia dividida com entradas independentes, com T1 na cave e T2 na moradia principal.

Cave composta por sala e cozinha (kitchinet), casa de banho com duche, e quarto de casal com pequena janela. Existe na zona da cozinha um termoacumulador.

Rés do chão composto por sala(com varanda e lareira com recuperador), uma casa de banho pequena, cozinha(com varanda fechada e um termoacumulador), um logradouro na parte de trás. O primeiro andar é composto por 2 quartos 1 deles com ar condicionado e varanda, e um sótão que tem escada retrátil onde também pode fazer mais um quarto.

O chão da casa é estilo rústico, de tijoleira. 

A Moradia fica a apenas 3mn da praia, e a 5mn do centro da cidade de Albufeira. Um imóvel excelente tanto para habitação como para rentabilizar, pois pode alugar as duas partes em simultaneo, porque têm entradas independentes.

Zona tranquila

Perto de escolas, praia, supermercados como Aldi e Intermarché e transportes públicos.

-

Semi-Detached Two-Family House with Independent Entrances

Semi-detached T3 property with a total living area of 120 m², divided into two independent living units, each with its own separate entrance: a one-bedroom apartment (T1) in the basement and a two-bedroom apartment (T2) in the main house.

Basement One-Bedroom Apartment (T1)

The basement comprises a living room and kitchenette, a bathroom with a shower, and a double bedroom with a small window. There is also an electric water heater in the kitchen area.

Ground Floor and First Floor Main House (T2)

The ground floor consists of a living room with a balcony and a wood-burning fireplace with a heat recovery system, a small bathroom, and a kitchen with an enclosed balcony and an electric water heater. At the rear of the property, there is also a private outdoor patio.

The first floor comprises two bedrooms, one of which benefits from air conditioning and a balcony.

The property also has an attic, accessible via a retractable staircase, which offers the possibility of creating an additional bedroom.

The floors throughout the house feature traditional rustic-style terracotta tiles.

Location and Investment Potential

The property is ideally located just 3 minutes from the beach and 5 minutes from Albufeira city centre.

An excellent opportunity, whether as a permanent residence, holiday home or investment property. Thanks to its two independent entrances and separate living units, both properties can be rented out simultaneously, offering excellent rental income potential.

Additional Features and Nearby Amenities

Quiet and peaceful residential area.

Close to schools.

Just minutes from the beach.

Convenient access to supermarkets, including Aldi and Intermarché.

Close to public transport.

An excellent opportunity to enjoy the Algarve lifestyle while benefiting from attractive rental potential.
